topNews.text: Voice Changes Measured by Phone Can Predict Asthma Flare-Ups 3 Days in Advance
topNews.excerpt: Voice changes measured with a mobile phone can detect an oncoming potentially-deadly asthma attack up to three days in advance, according to new research.
